description: Minify an SVG with SVGO. Send markup or a file as base64 or a public URL. Private addresses are refused and the file is capped at 10 MB. The viewBox is kept unless removeViewBox is true. Returns the optimized markup and the byte counts.

file.description: An SVG file. Provide svg or file.

data.description: Base64 bytes or a data URI. Decoded size is capped at 10 MB.

filename.description: File name, including the extension when you have one.

mimeType.description: MIME type when you know it.

url.description: Public http or https URL. Private and local addresses are refused.

svg.description: SVG markup. Provide svg or file.

name: optimize_svg
title: Optimize an SVG
